identificationModule.briefTitle: Radiation Therapy With Cisplatin or Cetuximab in Treating Patients With Oropharyngeal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase III Trial of Radiotherapy Plus Cetuximab Versus Chemoradiotherapy in HPV-Associated Oropharynx Cancer

interventions.name: cetuximab
interventions.description: 400 mg/m2 IV 5-7 days before IMRT then 250 mg/m2 IV weekly for 7 weeks

interventions.name: cisplatin
interventions.description: 100 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 22 of IMRT

interventions.name: IMRT
interventions.description: 35 fractions over 6 weeks, 6 fractions per week, 2 Gray per fraction to total dose of 70 Gy.
